newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads two Saudis for armed robbery.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads two Saudis for armed robbery.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Wednesday beheaded two Saudi nationals for armed robbery, raising to 53 the number of executions this year in the conservative kingdom.
A Saudi Interior Ministry statement carried by state-run television said the men had committed several armed robberies.
One man was beheaded in the eastern port city of Jeddah and the other in the eastern industrial city of Yanbu, the ministry statement said.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals. It executed a total of 68 people in 1996.
